cohort: The study included 100 placentas, chorionamnions, and cords from preterm deliveries between 28 0/7 and 36 6/7 weeks, categorized by the presence or absence of preterm rupture of membranes.
finding: Histological chorioamnionitis (HCA) was associated with vaginal delivery, lower gestational age, neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) admission, and a 5-minute Apgar score <7, but not with specific fetal heart rate patterns.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was associated with a higher likelihood of histological chorioamnionitis (OR: 2.4, 95% CI: 1.2-9.5, P < 0.05).
